title: 第25章 醒神丹突破第26章 黑市交易
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
呼噜灵域的淡银色光晕笼罩着废丹峰核心，如同一个巨大的、温暖的猫爪肉垫。
灵域内，猫薄荷的翠叶在月光下折射着银芒，以肉眼可见的速度舒展肥厚。
阿玳蹲在它简陋的露天丹坊里，三花尾巴得意地翘得老高，冰蓝、橙黄与雪白的三色绒毛在灵域微光下闪闪发亮。
炉底那三颗淡青色、远超寻常品质的回气散，如同勋章般躺在粗陶盘里。
“喵嗷！”
阿玳用爪子小心翼翼地将一颗回气散推给旁边趴着的铁爪，猫脸上满是“快夸我”
的炫耀。
铁爪低头嗅了嗅，金色的竖瞳里闪过一丝惊讶，随即伸出粗糙的舌头，极其珍重地将丹药卷入口中。
一股温和精纯的灵气迅速在它体内化开，连爪尖的金芒都似乎凝实了一分。
它喉咙里发出一声低沉的、带着赞许的呼噜，用脑袋蹭了蹭阿玳。
这无声的认可让阿玳彻底飘了！
“喵！
喵喵！”
它兴奋地原地转圈，尾巴尖高频抖动，指向丹炉，又指向远处呼噜灵域外那片生长在普通地块上的猫薄荷母株（林墨特意保留用于研究对比）。
意思很明显：灵域加持下的回气散都这么厉害，如果用灵域内生长、蕴含更强生机的猫薄荷，炼制更难的丹药呢？比如…主人提过的“清心丹”
清心丹，凡阶上品丹药，能短暂安抚心神，抵御低阶精神干扰，价值远超回气散。
林墨曾给阿玳看过简易丹方，但囿于材料匮乏和阿玳手艺不精，一直未尝试。
此刻，被成功冲昏头脑的阿玳，胆气爆棚！
它不再满足于用练稀的草药粉末和小丹炉。
它冲到灵域边缘，后腿直立，前爪并用，极其费力地拖拽着一个比它身体还大两圈的备用旧丹炉（林墨从废弃丹房捡来的），吭哧吭哧地挪回灵域内的丹坊。

接着，它又跑到那几株在灵域滋养下格外肥硕、叶片边缘银芒流转的猫薄荷旁，小爪子飞快地扒拉着，挑拣最肥厚、汁液最饱满的嫩叶。
它甚至嫌不够，又揪了几朵新开的、带着奇异甜香的淡紫色猫薄荷花！
“阿玳！
够了！”
林墨刚处理完灵蜂巢附近新生的几株伴生毒草（枯脉散残留引发的变异），一回头就看到阿玳像个暴发户一样，几乎要把小半株猫薄荷薅秃了塞进那巨大的旧丹炉里！
“喵！”
阿玳充耳不闻，完全沉浸在“大展宏图”
的兴奋中。
它把塞得满满当当的猫薄荷叶和花用力压实，然后尾巴卷起一根燃烧的木柴，凑近炉底通风口。
点火！
呼啦！
或许是塞入的猫薄荷太多，蕴含的生机太强，也或许是旧丹炉年久失修，炉壁有不易察觉的裂痕。
炉底火焰刚接触空气，瞬间就窜起一股不正常的、带着淡紫光晕的猛烈火舌！
“喵？！”
阿玳吓了一跳，尾巴下意识地一抖！
燃烧的木柴角度一偏，“嗤啦”
一声燎到了它尾巴尖的绒毛！
“嗷呜！”
剧痛让阿玳瞬间炸毛，尾巴像触电般猛地回缩！
这一缩不要紧，尾巴尖带着火星和一小撮烧焦的猫毛，好巧不巧，狠狠抽在了丹炉上方一个预留的、用于观察炉内情况的开口盖板上！

哐当！
盖板被抽开一道缝隙！
就在这电光火石的一瞬，丹炉内被高温烘烤、已经析出粘稠碧绿汁液的猫薄荷精华，在内部蒸腾气压的冲击下，“噗嗤”
一声，如同被挤压的果冻，猛地从开口缝隙中喷射出来！
content_en:
The pale silver halo of the Hulu Spirit Realm enveloped the core of the Waste Pill Peak, like a huge, warm cat's paw pad.
In the spiritual realm, the green leaves of catnip reflect silver light under the moonlight, stretching and thickening at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Ah Dai squatted in his simple open-air alchemy room, his three-flowered tail cocked high proudly, and his three-color fluff of ice blue, orange and snow-white sparkled in the dim light of the spiritual realm.
The three light cyan Qi Powders at the bottom of the furnace, which were of far superior quality, were lying on the stoneware plate like medals.
"Meow!"
Ah Dai carefully pushed a piece of Hui Qi Powder to Tie Zhao who was lying next to him with his paw. The cat's face was full of "Come on, praise me!"
of showing off.
Iron Claw lowered his head and sniffed, a hint of surprise flashed in his golden vertical pupils, then he stretched out his rough tongue and rolled the elixir into his mouth with great care.
A gentle and pure spiritual energy quickly spread within its body, and even the golden light on the tips of its claws seemed to solidify.
It let out a low, approving purr from its throat and rubbed its head against Ah Dai.
This silent recognition made Ah Dai completely stunned!
"Meow!
Meow! "
It was spinning around in circles excitedly, the tip of its tail trembling at high frequency, pointing at the Dan furnace, and then at the catnip mother plant growing on an ordinary plot of land outside the Sululing territory in the distance (Lin Mo specially reserved it for research and comparison).
The meaning is obvious: the Qi-Reviving Powder blessed by the spiritual realm is so powerful. What if the catnip that grows in the spiritual realm and contains stronger vitality is used to refine more difficult elixirs? For example...the "Qingxin Pill" mentioned by the owner
Qingxin Dan, a high-grade ordinary-level elixir, can temporarily soothe the mind and resist low-level mental interference. Its value is far more than that of the Qi-Returning Powder.
Lin Mo once showed Ah Dai a simple recipe for elixirs, but due to lack of materials and Ah Dai's poor craftsmanship, he never tried it.
At this moment, A'Dai, who was dazzled by success, was filled with courage!
It is no longer satisfied with diluted herbal powders and small alchemy furnaces.
It rushed to the edge of the spiritual realm, stood up on its hind legs, and used its front paws together. It dragged an old spare alchemy furnace (which Lin Mo picked up from an abandoned alchemy room) that was two circles larger than its body with great effort, and moved it back to the alchemy workshop in the spiritual realm.
Then, it ran to the few catmint plants that were particularly plump under the nourishment of the spiritual realm, and the edges of the leaves were flowing with silver light. It quickly plucked with its little paws, picking out the thickest and juiciest young leaves.
It didn't even think it was enough, so it picked out a few newly bloomed lavender catnip flowers with a strange and sweet fragrance!
"A'Dai!
Enough! "
Lin Mo had just finished dealing with several new associated poisonous weeds (mutations caused by the residue of Kumai Powder) near the spirit beehive. When he turned around, he saw Ah Dai, like a nouveau riche, almost plucking half of the catmint plant and stuffing it into the huge old alchemy furnace!
"Meow!"
A'Dai turned a deaf ear and was completely immersed in "making great achievements"
in excitement.
It pressed the stuffed catnip leaves and flowers firmly, then rolled up a burning log with its tail and moved it close to the vent at the bottom of the stove.
ignition!
Hooray!
Maybe there was too much catnip stuffed in and the vitality contained in it was too strong, or maybe the old alchemy furnace was in disrepair and there were cracks on the furnace wall that were not easy to detect.
As soon as the flame at the bottom of the furnace came into contact with the air, an abnormal and fierce tongue of flame with a lavender halo burst out instantly!
"Meow?!"
A'Dai was startled and his tail twitched subconsciously!
The angle of the burning firewood turned to one side and "chila"
The sound caught the fluff on the tip of its tail!
"Ouch!"
The severe pain caused A'Dai's hair to explode in an instant, and his tail suddenly retracted like an electric shock!
It didn't matter that he was shrinking, the tip of his tail was carrying sparks and a handful of burnt cat hair. By coincidence, it hit an open cover above the alchemy furnace that was reserved for observing the situation inside the furnace!
Bang!
The cover was pulled open a gap!
In this flash of lightning, the catnip essence that had been baked at high temperatures in the elixir furnace and had precipitated thick green juice, "poofed" under the impact of the internal steam pressure.
A sound, like being squeezedJelly suddenly spurted out from the gap in the opening!
